obd.connectSubtitle: BLE ELM327 only — read codes and live sensors, then diagnose in Chat.
obd.step1: Plug a BLE ELM327 adapter into the OBD-II port (usually under the dash, left of the steering column).
obd.step2: Turn the ignition ON (engine can stay off). Wait for the adapter LED.
obd.step3: Tap Connect and pick your BLE adapter in the system Bluetooth list (Chrome on Android/desktop).
obd.step4: We read stored/pending DTCs and basic sensors, then open diagnosis in Chat. Keep this sheet open to Read again or Disconnect.
obd.bleOnlyBanner: Currently only BLE (Bluetooth Low Energy) ELM327 adapters are supported. Classic Bluetooth is not supported in the browser.
obd.bleOnlyNote: Look for packaging that says BLE, Bluetooth 4.0+, or “Bluetooth Low Energy”. Older classic-only dongles will not appear or will fail to connect.
obd.iosUnsupported: iOS (including the App Store app) cannot use live Bluetooth OBD. Enter the fault code manually or upload an OBD screenshot. BLE OBD works on Chrome for Android/desktop with a BLE ELM327 adapter.
obd.browserUnsupported: Web Bluetooth is not available in this browser. Use Chrome or Edge on Android/desktop with a BLE ELM327 adapter. On iOS, use Enter fault code or OBD screenshot instead.
obd.iosTip: iOS tip: Bluetooth OBD is not available yet — use Enter fault code or OBD screenshot.
obd.workingHint: Keep the phone near the BLE adapter. Do not leave this screen.
obd.injectedHint: Diagnosis was sent to Chat. You can Read again or Disconnect here.
obd.dashboardSyncedHint: Codes and sensors were saved to this vehicle’s Dashboard. Ask AI to open diagnosis in Chat, or Read again / Disconnect.
obd.noCodes: No stored or pending codes reported.
obd.errorGeneric: OBD connection or read failed. Confirm you have a BLE ELM327 (not Classic Bluetooth) and try again.
obd.toolsSectionHint: Optional hardware preferences. Change these anytime — they only adjust Connect OBD visibility, not diagnosis quality.
obd.prefToggleHelp: Enable Bluetooth OBD connection (ELM327). When off, you can still enter codes manually or upload screenshots.
obd.prefUnsetHint: Off by default. Turn on when you have a BLE ELM327 adapter (Chrome on Android/desktop).
obd.prefPromptTitle: Do you use an OBD adapter?
obd.prefPromptBody: If you have an OBD-II Bluetooth adapter, we can show Connect OBD. If not, keep using Enter fault code or an OBD screenshot (e.g. from a parts-store scan).
obd.prefPromptNote: You can change this later in Settings → Tools / Garage.
obd.iosPreferManual: On this device, prefer Enter fault code or an OBD screenshot instead of live Bluetooth.
obd.noAdapterLiveHint: Bluetooth OBD is off. Enable “I have an OBD-II adapter” in Settings to connect, or use Enter fault code / OBD screenshot.
obd.bleBlockedByPref: Turn on “I have an OBD-II adapter” in Settings before connecting Bluetooth OBD.
